title: Hollowroad Listener
text: Hollowroad Listener hums into empty tunnels and follows the returning note toward living prey. On loss, suffer 1 Wound.
flavor: The road answers in your voice.

defeatReward.text: Hollowroad Listener is defeated and its identifying marks are entered into your Trophy Pile.
